lede: Cincinnati Bengals carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#12 in EPA per play), while Houston Texans owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#3 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Houston Texans -6.0 with a fair total of 47.2 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Cincinnati Bengals pass offence vs Houston Texans pass defence, which sits −0.174 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
